title: Polynomial Bound for Unary Polynomial-Time Functions
statement: If $\ell$ is a function on finite binary strings whose unary representation is computable in polynomial time, then there are natural numbers $A,a$ such that, for every binary string $y$, $\ell(y)\le A(|y|+1)^a$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ has a polynomial-time computable unary representation
